criteria.text: Progress matches persisted jobs, artifacts, sources, elapsed time, profile/model, and session usage.
criteria.test_id: issue-1294-c1: derives factual progress and usage

criteria.text: Cancellation reaches the live engine, is idempotent, and preserves completed artifacts.
criteria.test_id: issue-1294-c2: aborts active work without deleting completed artifacts

criteria.text: Selective retry preserves successful passes and invalidates downstream stages without duplicate rows.
criteria.test_id: issue-1294-c3: retries only the selected pass and stale stages

criteria.text: Restart recovery marks active work interrupted and does not rerun completed passes.
criteria.test_id: issue-1294-c4: resumes only unfinished work after restart

criteria.text: Pass, timeout, wall-clock, token, and cost limits prevent later stages with a clear budget-exhausted status.
criteria.test_id: issue-1294-c5: blocks downstream work when a persisted budget is exhausted

not_tested: Live engine abort and restart-resume require the isolated sandbox and are covered by #1300 live validation.
